Ambubachi Mela Concludes, Kamakhya Temple Reopens in Assam

The Ambubachi Mela in Assam has concluded, leading to the reopening of the Kamakhya temple doors for devotees. The annual event saw lakhs of devotees gather in Guwahati. Following the conclusion of the mela, the temple has resumed its normal operations, allowing pilgrims to visit.
